close_reason: Decision records, no code change needed
description: validate_path checks that for a self-issued last cert, the trust anchor's SPKI matches the cert's SPKI. This guards against name-collision attacks: an attacker presenting a cert with the same DN as a trusted anchor but a different key is rejected. The test forged_anchor_name_match_spki_mismatch_rejected covers this. Future contributors may simplify the anchor loop and remove this guard — do not.
title: Self-issued SPKI mismatch guard in validate_path is a correct security check
